answer: Admission requires an applicant to dock at one numbered physical jetty, a port serving one handshake at a time, while the registry measures the drift delta of that device's quartz oscillator from timestamped round trips. The delta is stored as the hardware fingerprint: two identities whose deltas fall inside the same tolerance band sit on one board, so both are rejected. A farmer must rent N jetty ports and N separate quartz devices, each billed separately with no bulk discount, while an honest agent pays once.
